title: Restore E-Document vendor invoice field compatibility
summary: E-Document vendor invoice field name restored from 'Applies-to Ext. Invoice No.' to 'Vendor Invoice No.' across handlers, tests, and documentation to maintain upgrade and extension compatibility.
key_points: Field 40 in E-Document Purchase Header renamed back to 'Vendor Invoice No.' for compatibility
All APAC, DE, DK, ES, and FR handlers updated to use the restored field name
Test cases and documentation aligned with the field name change
Ensures existing extensions and translations continue to work
Resolves upgrade compatibility issues introduced by the previous rename
quote: Restores field 40 and W1 E-Document processing to use `Vendor Invoice No.`
